Data base
Empower Your Platform with Secure, Scalable Data Solutions with our Database Expertise
Market Cloud provides a comprehensive suite of database solutions to ensure your platform's data is secure, scalable, and readily accessible. We leverage a wide range of industry-leading database technologies to meet your specific project requirements. Our team of experienced database architects will help you select the optimal solution based on your data structure, performance needs, and scaleability goals.
Relational Powerhouses
MySQL
The world's most popular open-source relational database management system (RDBMS), MySQL excels at handling structured data and complex queries. Ideal for a wide range of applications.
Postgre SQL
A powerful and open-source object-relational database management system (ORDBMS), PostgreSQL offers advanced features like data integrity and robust security, making it a great choice for complex data models.
Kafka
Kafka can be used to process payments, financial transactions, etc., in real-time. It can be used to track and monitor cars, trucks, fleets, and shipments in real-time.
Contact us today to build a robust data foundation for your organization's future!
Get a Consultation
NoSQL Flexibility
MSSQL
Leverages the power and scalability of Microsoft's enterprise-grade RDBMS. MS SQL integrates seamlessly with other Microsoft technologies, making it a strong choice for NET-based applications.
MongoDB
A popular NoSQL document database, MongoDB offers flexibility and scalability for storing and managing unstructured and semi-structured data.
Cassandra
A distributed NoSQL database known for high availability and scalability, Cassandra is ideal for managing large datasets across multiple servers.
CouchDB
A flexible NoSQL document database with a focus and offline capabilities. CouchDB is well-suited for web applications and collaborative environments.
Specialized Solutions
Neo4j
A powerful graph database, Neo4j excels in handling connected data and complex relationships between entities. Ideal for social networking platforms, recommendation engines, and knowledge graphs.
ArangoDB
A flexible NoSQL database that seamlessly combines document, graph, and key-value data models, ArangoDB offers high performance and scalability for diverse data management needs.
Essential Tools
Elasticsearch
A powerful search engine and analytics platform built on top of Apache Lucene, Elasticsearch allows for fast and efficient searching of large datasets.
Simple Queue Service
A highly scalable and managed message queuing service offered by AWS, SQS helps decouple applications and ensure reliable message delivery.
ZeroMQ
A high-performance, lightweight messaging library, ZeroMQ offers flexibility and low latency for real-time communication between applications.
RabbitMQ
A popular open-source message broker, RabbitMQ provides reliable message queuing, routing, and exchange functionalities for distributed applications.
